utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Tuesday the sixth. Can you all hear me over that fan?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, just. Sorry I'm a bit flustered, traffic on the ring road was absolutely ridiculous.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: So, normal traffic on the ring road, then?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Pretty much. Had ages to look at the same bloke's brake lights.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Well, there's a birthday cake in the office, if that improves things.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Depends. Proper cake or one of those healthy ones?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Proper cake. Right, before this becomes the cake meeting—what's already closed out? Atlas?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I already swapped the filter on the Atlas yesterday. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And I tested the Atlas yesterday and it's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, you both came through together a bit. Filter changed and tested, both finished?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Both finished, yeah. Nothing outstanding from that test.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Closed, not another job for today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Only an observation from me: noticed the Water Booster Pump was running a bit warm on nights, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Settled while it was still running, you mean?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah. Not raising a job off it, just passing on what nights said.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, observation only.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Um, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the 11kV board. Same blocker as before.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So there's still no confirmed delivery to put against it?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: No. Still blocked, no change. I'm not announcing a date or a new action there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. And the shutdown on the power pack on one is cancelled now, production need it running.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, cancelled altogether, not just moved a few hours?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cancelled. No shutdown work on that coming out of this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tommo, can you schedule downtime for the turbine two with production, by next Tuesday?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah—just to be clear, you want the downtime arranged by next Tuesday, not me assuming that's the actual outage day?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Agree the downtime with production by next Tuesday. We're not fixing the outage day on this call.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, I'll schedule downtime for the turbine two with production by next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, better than us putting a slot in and calling it agreed when it isn't.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Quite. A coloured square isn't permission, much as we'd like it to be.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fi, can you do the pre-use checks on the counterbalances? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do the pre-use checks on the counterbalances. That's my top priority.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, pre-use being the important bit there. Not paperwork after they've already been used.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Absolutely. Checks before use, understood.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Next, spares. Can you order spare parts for the little water valve on two? Next week, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Me? Sorry, no, I can't take that one on. I haven't got the capacity for the ordering as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Ash, can you take that instead—order spare parts for the little water valve on two next week? No rush.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it instead. I'll order spare parts for the little water valve on two next week.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Cheers. And that's not suddenly an urgent one because it's changed hands?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, same as before. No rush, next week.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Fine by me. That's clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We've also got the shift handover report to send round. Whenever you get a chance sort of thing, not an urgent one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll send the shift handover report round.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace. Whenever you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, understood. Not putting it ahead of the priority checks.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, did you say the test report or the shift handover report? Audio clipped.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Shift handover report. The Atlas test is finished, that wasn't another action.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Doyler, can you investigate the pressure drop on the line one HPU by Monday?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep. Fi for the checks, Doyler for the pressure drop. Sadly still only one of me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I know, the budget won't stretch to a second one. Monday for that investigation.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Okay, I'll investigate the pressure drop on the line one HPU by Monday. The counterbalances checks stay top priority.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Investigation only at this point, yeah? Not agreeing a strip-down here?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct, investigate the pressure drop. We're not adding a strip-down to it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, that's what I've got.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Han, can you chase the purchase order for the desiccant unit by 11am?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll chase the purchase order for the desiccant unit by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And that's separate from my supplier delivery blocker, just so we don't muddle the two?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, separate. The 11kV board is still blocked; this is the purchase order for the desiccant unit.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Got it. Chase by 11am, not a promise that the order will be released by then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. That's the six actions covered, and the cancelled shutdown stays cancelled.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: That last bit came through beautifully. Teams apparently likes us more at the end.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Either that or the fan's finally stopped competing with you.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I heard cake perfectly at the start, to be fair.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Selective hearing. Very common engineering condition.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, on that highly technical note, thanks everyone. End there.
